decision.explanation: The ceramic serving bowl from order O0037 was received broken (damaged) and is reported within the 7- or 10-day return window. Despite no photo evidence being provided (and it being above the 2000 INR threshold is not relevant since item price is 399), the item price is under 500, so immediate refund without return is allowed only for wrong items under 500 (E5), but this is damaged. Damaged items require pickup (E5). Hence, a return is scheduled with no immediate refund. Refund will be made automatically after pickup completion per policy. User confirmation will be sought before taking irrevocable actions on refund or return. Since the policy is LOCKED and refund over 5000 is not relevant, no escalation. Presented action for user confirmation.
